paper.title: An optimization framework for wind farm layout design using CFD-based Kriging model

target_contributions: adaptive high-fidelity CFD-response dataset with optimum-design infill
Gaussian-correlation Kriging surrogate coupled to a genetic algorithm
three discrete eight-turbine flat and Gaussian-hill wind-farm cases

source_assets.author_code: no paper-linked modified simpleFoam ADM, Kriging or GA source located
source_assets.author_data: no paper-linked mesh, CFD response table, initial LHS or optimization trace located

paper_native_cases.common: 8 NREL 5 MW turbines, 81 nodes on an 8D by 8D square, at least 2D spacing
paper_native_cases.case1: flat, one 11.4 m/s west wind state, 437 reported SBO CFD calls
paper_native_cases.case2: flat, eight source-figure wind bins, 400 reported SBO CFD calls
paper_native_cases.case3: 150 m Gaussian hill, same eight wind bins, 399 reported SBO CFD calls

model_contract.objective: maximize AEP using the paper calendar-hour expression
model_contract.truth_target: ADM-RANS Eqs. (1)-(7) in a circular OpenFOAM domain
model_contract.surrogate: ordinary Kriging Eqs. (8)-(12) with Gaussian correlation and MLE hyperparameter
model_contract.adaptive_lifecycle: 360 LHS truth responses, fit Kriging, optimize surrogate, truth-evaluate optimum, append and refit
model_contract.turbine: NREL 5 MW, D=126 m, hub=90 m, rated=11.4 m/s, cut-in=3 m/s, cut-out=25 m/s

missing_fields: OpenFOAM dictionaries, meshes and convergence tolerances
GA selection, crossover and mutation operators

declared_completions.truth_backend: non-CFD terrain-aware ADM/Gaussian response proxy; never labeled OpenFOAM or author CFD
declared_completions.windrose: eight bins transcribed from the CC-BY source Figure 6 and normalized; west and southwest use paper-printed values
declared_completions.source_baseline: eight indices transcribed from source Figure 7(c)
declared_completions.truth_scale: isolated deficit and case-response factors calibrated only to the three Table 5 baseline AEP scales
declared_completions.lhs: 16-dimensional discrete Latin-hypercube strata followed by nearest feasible node repair
declared_completions.kriging: constant trend, Gaussian kernel, six-value initial MLE scan, nugget 1e-8 and exact rank-one Cholesky updates
declared_completions.crossover: feasible random-key selection from the two-parent node union

hpc_contract.truth: all initial truth calls evaluated on one persistent full-core team
hpc_contract.kriging: rank-one updates replace repeated cubic refits after the initial factorization
hpc_contract.ga: surrogate inference and schedule-independent offspring generation parallelized on the persistent team
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: maximum twenty aggregate Waffle CPU workers without nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the paper problem, adaptive Kriging-GA method and all three cases on a versioned ADM/Gaussian truth proxy; not OpenFOAM CFD, author code/data/meshes, exact operators, random state, AEP or numerical replay
